messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key movement between cards in [the board focus handler](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:28). Movement stops at board edges, keeps the focused card visible, and leaves modified key combinations to the browser.

Added [browser regression coverage](/work/tests/input-contract.e2e.test.ts:27) for matched cards, pending mismatches, and modifier keys. Type checking, formatting, the build, and all 138 unit tests passed. The browser suite passed 75 checks; one unrelated face-art check timed out in the full run and passed when rerun separately.
